title: Waste organic solvents

review.classification: The whole non-halogenated wet feed has retained its solvent character after use and is destined for off-site regeneration. The acetone assay, a recovered chemical, virgin coproduct 34139, inorganic mother liquor 39950, packaging and regeneration services are distinct. Confirm actual contaminant and halogen history and classification at the defined gate.
review.primary_evidence: Facility operating descriptions demonstrate that the route occurred. The 1991 EPA guide supports the specific prior cleaning context. Neither document alone establishes the actual lot, receiver licence, acceptance, attributable emissions or mass fractions; require study records before use.
review.measurement: Separate generator dispatch, pending waste, the once-only receiver acceptance Q and later stock movements. Controller probe: opening accepted stock 7 kg, first accepted 5 kg, transferred onwards 9 kg and closing 3 kg gives Q = 5 kg. As a separate synthetic test, 200 lb av whole shipped at an independently verified representative 30 percent mass fraction means 90.718474 kg whole and 27.2155422 kg constituent; neither quantity alone is receiving Q or an emission. Bulk and assay views are non-additive. Preserve raw zero-output burdens and exchange-specific allocation. Post-release services use the original cohort; no avoided-production credit follows from a permit. Both canonical language files and the final author arithmetic receipt include the corrected accepted-stock balance; initial overly broad closing-stock language was repaired before the author commit.
review.native_records: Independent public reads establish two specific unspecified-air elementary flows, tap water and AC electricity. The AC exchange is pinned to named version 01.01.003 with its native reference property; metered kWh and supplier coverage remain separately qualified. Concentrated waste solutions classified 39940 lack the product identity, and the native steel drum has CTUe as reference property. Do not substitute them for kg of spent liquid or kg of packaging. Distinct indoor-air and agricultural-soil acetone exchanges are outside this scope. The AC original is geographically and electrically bounded to Chinese grid-average supply below 1 kV, and cannot be the electricity provider of the historical Arkansas case.
review.readiness: Candidate/authored_methodology with bilingual aligned texts. Scientific approval, independent translation approval and publication remain pending. Concrete data require receiver qualification, actual balances and supplier scopes. The specific whole-wet-solvent Product UUID remains unresolved.

sources.role: Frozen UN 2025 listing, p.205, identifies waste solvents and adjacent waste categories.
US EPA pollution-prevention guidance documents liquid solvent contamination during FRP tool cleaning. Method applicability requires actual segregated feed and receiver evidence.
R11 describes prior operation of the same facility, first verified under its own period; the author retained both original records.

Arkansas R13, printed p.6 confirms the off-site route. Condition 37 printed pp.42–43 distinguishes incoming pollutant, mass shipped, composite sampling across containers, external laboratory analysis, pollutant amount and waste awaiting shipment.
Earlier on-site reclamation is counterevidence for transferring plant history indiscriminately.
US EPA original assessment distinguishes off-site reclamation from on-site recovery. Generic balances, estimates and factors are outside this single-lot method.
EPA biennial reports can corroborate a reporting period but do not establish one shipment assay, site receipt or destination approval.
CPC3 row 1943 binds 39940 to the HS 3825.41/.49 family; selected non-halogenated portion is narrower and must be independently identified.

delivery_gate: Full npm run validate is required on the exact integration source.
